02 LEAGUE PULSE BEYOND THE TABLE
One Point TITLE RACE
Gian Jaen 323 — Bart Simp 322. The narrowest lead of
the season so far. Bart posted the GW4 high score of
104 on a Wildcard and still could not take the top spot;
Gian’s Free Hit answered with 92. A single bonus point
either way flips this table.
João Pedro Cult 7 OF 21
Seven managers handed the armband to João Pedro
(12 pts) — the most-captained player in the league and
owned by 17 of 21 squads. Haaland’s grip is loosening:
only 4 captained him, down from 11 in GW3.
Everyone Scored HIGHEST AVG YET
A 72.8 league average is the best of the season — up
from 53.2 in GW3. Even 21st place (Nico Zarzaua, 45)
beat the GW3 league low. Brighton and Hull returns were
spread everywhere.
The Untouched ZERO TRANSFERS
Five managers have made zero transfers all season :
Jose Castrejon (3rd), Abner Chavez (12th), danny lopez
(15th), Nico Zarzaua (18th) and Alex Bruce (21st). One of
them sits third. Doing nothing remains a viable strategy.
Value Arms Race £2,102.7M
Combined squad value across 21 managers averages
£100.13m . Drin Pacuku fields the most expensive
squad at £101.3m — and sits 16th. Cheapest is Abner
Chavez at £99.2m, who is four places higher.
Chips Left INVENTORY
After GW4: Free Hit 18/21 , Wildcard 17/21 , Bench
Boost 15/21 , Triple Captain 10/21 . Eleven managers
have now spent a Triple Captain — and three of the top

02 GAMEWEEK CURIOSITIES NINE THINGS THAT ACTUALLY HAPPENED
The Dead Captain ABSURD
Abner Chavez captained Ollie Watkins — who has
permanently joined Al Hilal and played 0 minutes . The
armband auto-passed to vice-captain David Raya , who
returned 14 (x2 = 28). Abner still scored 90 , the 4th-best
GW4 haul in the league. Failing upward is a skill.
Worst Chip in History TRIPLE CAPTAIN
Nick Revia fired his Triple Captain on João Pedro for a
12-point base — the chip added just +12 . He
simultaneously left 21 points on his bench , the most in
the league. His chip was worth less than his bench-order
mistake.
The Defender Gamble ALSO TRIPLE CAPTAIN
Chris Tran triple-captained a centre-back, Virgil van
Dijk , who returned 8 in a 0-0 draw — the chip added +8 .
Two Triple Captains were spent in GW4 and they
generated 20 combined bonus points between them.
Season-High Score 104 PTS
Bart Simp 's Wildcard produced 104 — the best score in
the league this gameweek by 9 clear points. It still
clawed back only one point on Gian Jaen, who
answered with a 92-point Free Hit.
Bench Boost Whi ff +8 ONLY
Marie Drosche played her Bench Boost and the four
bench players contributed 8 points . She scored 86
anyway. For contrast, three managers who played no
chip left more than 8 points on their bench by accident.
141 Points Binned LEAGUE WASTE
The league collectively benched 141 points in GW4 —
an average of 6.7 per manager. Nick Revia (21), Khang
Dang (17) and Giancarlos Castaneda (17) account for a
third of it between them.
Doing Nothing Works JOSE 84
Jose Castrejon scored 84 having made zero transfers
all season — 3rd overall on the squad he picked in
August.
Captain Spread 9 NAMES

João Pedro captains averaged 73.9 ; the four Haaland
captains averaged just 61.8 .
Free Hit Trio AVG 86.7
All three Free Hits landed above average: Khang Dang
95 , Gian Jaen 92 , Alexis Segura 73 . The chip is 3-for-3 in
this league. 03 BLUNDERS OF THE WEEK DECISIONS THAT COST REAL POINTS
Blunder of the Week −20 POINTS
Cameron Walker made six transfers on a one-transfer
budget, eating a −20 hit — the single biggest hit taken
by anyone in this league all season. He then captained
Ødegaard , who returned 3 (×2 = 6).
His gross 74 became a net 54 . He was 1st in GW1; he is
now 10th , the steepest fall in the league.
The Bench-Order Tax 21 POINTS
Nick Revia left 21 points on the bench while playing his
Triple Captain. The chip added +12. Net e ffect: his bench
mistake cost more than his chip earned .
Season hits: −24 . He has burned the most points on
transfers of anyone here and sits 14th.
Quiet Collapse ▼ 9 AND ▼ 8
Cameron Walker (1st → 10th) and both Aleksa Divcic
(3rd → 11th) and Nick Revia (6th → 14th) have shed eight
or more places since GW1.
All three led or sat top-6 after opening weekend. None
has scored above 74 since GW2.
The Two-Week Surge GIAN +14
Gian Jaen was 15th after GW1 with 39 points — the
4th-worst opening score in the league. He is now 1st
with 323. His GW2 (115) remains the highest single
gameweek anyone here has posted.
Biggest Riser ALEXIS +12
Alexis Segura opened with 34 — second-worst in the
league — and has climbed from 18th to 6th . His GW2 of
117 is the outright league record for a single gameweek.
Frozen in Place 5 MANAGERS
Unmoved since GW1: El Cochiloco (#4), Saka la bolsita
(#5), sakadeez (#16), are you aMAD (#20). Alfonso
Castrejon has held 4th and Phillip Lopez 5th for four
straight gameweeks without ever swapping positions.
The League Heartbeat AVG BY GW
GW1 49.1 → GW2 82.4 → GW3 53.2 → GW4 72.8 . The
league oscillates violently between blank and boom
weeks. GW2 remains the high-water mark, but GW4 is
the best-spread week: nobody scored under 45.
Volatility Index SWING RANGE
Widest boom-bust swing belongs to Alexis Segura (34
to 117, a 83-point range ), then Gian Jaen (39–115, 76).
The two most volatile managers sit 6th and 1st. The
steadiest, Nico Zarzaua (42–66), sits 18th.
Season Hits Ledger −52 TOTAL
Only four managers have taken a hit all season: Nick
Revia −24 , Cameron Walker −20 , Aleksa Divcic −4 ,
Giancarlos Castaneda −4 . That is 52 points incinerated
— and all four sit 10th or lower.
Podium Congestion 24 PTS
3rd to 6th — 306 , 292 , 291 , 282 — sit within 24 points .
One boom week reorders the whole podium chase.
The Chasm 145 POINTS
1st ( 323 ) to 20th ( 178 ) spans 145 points , yet 2nd to 11th
is only 64 . A tight bunch of ten, then a long tail.

Undervalued = points per £million, minimum 240
minutes played. Overperforming = goals+assists minus
expected goals+assists — a positive number means
finishing above the underlying chances, which
historically regresses.

players with 200+ minutes. None of these are
predictions; they are descriptions of what has already
happened.

01 THE MIXED ZONE RUST-COLOURED QUESTIONS ARE THE ONES NOBODY WANTED
Gaucho F.C. GUARDED OPTIMISM #01 • 323
Q. You lead by one point with your Wildcard still in hand. Do you
play it or protect the lead?
A. I hold it. My Free Hit did its job — 92 and top spot. Playing a
Wildcard to defend a one-point lead is how you end up 6th by
October.
Q. Your bench has now cost you 8, 16 and 13 points in three
separate weeks. Is bench-ordering a personal weakness?
A. I've won this league from 15th on the back of transfers, not
